candidates.change_summary: Change the required incoming value from exactly 10 ether to at least 10 ether (>=) which alters when the fallback proceeds and thus can change pastBlockTime.
Remove the timestamp ordering guard so fallback can update pastBlockTime regardless of block.timestamp, changing resulting state.
Set pastBlockTime to block.timestamp (instead of block.timestamp + 1), causing a different stored value after the call.

Unconditionally transfer contract balance to msg.sender (remove the block.number % 15 check), changing state visible via subsequent calls due to balance change and any effect on pastBlockTime sequencing.
Change the transfer target to address(this) (no-op transfer) so the contract balance remains, altering externally observable balance behavior and potential reentrancy outcomes.
